question.problem:
Suppose we wish to find a critical point of the function $f(x,y)$ in the region $[-1,1]\times [-1,1]⊆{R}^{2},$ where $$ f(x,y)=2{x}^{2}y+3{x}^{2}-3xy+2x-{y}^{2}-5. $$ Calculate one iteration of the Newton-Raphson process for optimization that starts at ${x}_{0}=[-1,\,-1]^{T}.$ Round your final answer to **three decimal places.**
${x}_{1}≈[$ {{field-1}} $]$
{{field-2}}
question.worked_solution:
The Newton-Raphson method of optimizing a multivariable function $f:{R}^{n}\to R$ is

$$
{x}_{n+1}={x}_{n}-[{H}_{f}({x}_{n})]^{-1}∇f({x}_{n}),
$$

where $H({x}_{n})$ and $∇f({x}_{n})$ are the Hessian and gradient of $f$, respectively, evaluated at ${x}_{n}.$

In our case, the gradient is

$$
\begin{aligned}∇f(x) & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{∂}{∂x}(2{x}^{2}y+3{x}^{2}-3xy+2x-{y}^{2}-5) \\ \frac{∂}{∂y}(2{x}^{2}y+3{x}^{2}-3xy+2x-{y}^{2}-5)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4xy+6x-3y+2 \\ 2{x}^{2}-3x-2y\end{aligned}],\end{aligned}
$$

and the Hessian is

$$
\begin{aligned}{H}_{f}(x) & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{∂}{∂x}(4xy+6x-3y+2) & \frac{∂}{∂x}(2{x}^{2}-3x-2y) \\ \frac{∂}{∂y}(4xy+6x-3y+2) & \frac{∂}{∂y}(2{x}^{2}-3x-2y)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4y+6 & 4x-3 \\ 4x-3 & -2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, our Newton-Raphson formula is

$$
{x}_{n+1}={x}_{n}-{[\begin{aligned}4y+6 & 4x-3 \\ 4x-3 & -2\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{n}}^{-1}{[\begin{aligned}4xy+6x-3y+2 \\ 2{x}^{2}-3x-2y\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{n}}.
$$

Starting with
${x}_{0}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -1\end{aligned}],$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} & ={x}_{0}-{[\begin{aligned}4y+6 & 4x-3 \\ 4x-3 & -2\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{0}}^{-1}{[\begin{aligned}4xy+6x-3y+2 \\ 2{x}^{2}-3x-2y\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{0}} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]-{[\begin{aligned}4(-1)+6 & 4(-1)-3 \\ 4(-1)-3 & -2\end{aligned}]}^{-1}[\begin{aligned}4(-1)(-1)+6(-1)-3(-1)+2 \\ 2(-1)^{2}-3(-1)-2(-1)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]-{[\begin{aligned}2 & -7 \\ -7 & -2\end{aligned}]}^{-1}[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 7\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]-\frac{1}{2\cdot (-2)-(-7)\cdot (-7)}[\begin{aligned}-2 & 7 \\ 7 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}3 \\ 7\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]+\frac{1}{53}[\begin{aligned}43 \\ 35\end{aligned}] \\  & ≈[\begin{aligned}-0.189 \\ -0.340\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
